items.value: Stack the falling hay so we can help Farmer to save up for winter!
We finished very fast! Farmer can go on vacation early!
We failed the job... Now Farmer needs to cancel his vacation!
Are your reflexes ready? Because we need to stack fast in Haystack Fever!
I will toss some hay bales and they will come down to you.
When you catch it, i will move on to launch the next piece!

When i see that you the hand on it, i will speed up.
So i hope Dr.Reflex helped you!

Not always you will be able to catch the falling hays...
Only 2 or 3 missed hays should be fine.
When you get 3 Strikes, it's game over!
